approval.standard: eastward-edges.md 5.1 and 5.5, art-style.md density 3; the Frostline brief (snow lying on what faces the sky, granite and slate, lake ice)
approval.note: The one dark lead in the frozen tarn (Matt, 23 Nov), where the outlet leaves: shut at its north, opening south into the outlet's open water; a dark centre, lighter shallows, the shelf ice's snowy lip round it and its shadow on the water.

audit.size_class: unsized (open water in the tarn's ice: ground dressing on the ice)
